source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 327 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 327.

PD 327.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 327 was established by Ordinance No. 20532, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 13, 1989. Ordinance No. 20532 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 327 is established on property generally located along the northwest line of Greenville Avenue, southwest of the south line of Forest Lane. The size of PD 327 is approximately 2.6 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and provisions contained in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to code articles, divisions, and sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, and sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Development of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 327A). (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

A detailed development plan for each phase of development must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of any building permit for that phase. Approval of the detailed development plan replaces any residential adjacency review or development impact review otherwise required by the Dallas Development Code. No time limit exists for the submission of the detailed development plan for Phase I. Each detailed development plan must include the site plan requisites listed in Section 51A-4.803(d). In deciding whether to approve or deny the development plan, the city plan commission shall follow the standards set out for the director of development services in Section 51A-4.803. Development on the Property must comply with the approved detailed development plans. The applicant must forward a copy of each development plan to the president of the Greenville Avenue Homeowner’s Association, if the association is in existence, and to the executive director of the Dallas Housing Authority. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.106. USES.

(a) The following uses are the only main uses permitted on the Property:

(1) Building repair and maintenance shop.

(2) Catering service.

(3) Custom business services.

(4) Electronics service center.

(5) Medical or scientific laboratory. [SUP]

(6) Tool or equipment rental.

(7) Institution for special education.

(8) Residential hotel.

(9) Financial institution with drive-in window.

(10) Animal shelter or clinic without outside runs.

(11) Business school.

(12) Commercial amusement (inside), excluding pool halls and arcades.

(13) Furniture store.

(14) General merchandise or food store greater than 3,500 square feet.

(15) Household equipment and appliance repair.

(16) Mortuary, funeral home, or commercial wedding chapel.

(17) Nursery, garden shop, or plant sales.

(18) Temporary retail use.

(19) Residential uses permitted in the MF-2(A) Multifamily District.

(20) Uses permitted in the NS(A) Neighborhood Service District.

(b) A dry cleaning or laundry store use is expressly prohibited on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Floor Area Ratio
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.107. FLOOR AREA RATIO.

(a) Maximum floor area ratio for retail and personal service uses is 0.3.

(b) Maximum floor are ratio for all nonresidential uses combined is 0.5. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Dwelling Unit Density
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.108. DWELLING UNIT DENSITY.

Maximum dwelling unit (“DU”) density is 18 dwelling units per acre. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.109. LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum lot coverage permitted is 40 percent. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.110. HEIGHT.

(a) Except as provided below, maximum structure height for all structures on the Property is 30 feet.

(b) Maximum height of a structure with a hip, gable, or gambrel roof is 35 feet.

(c) If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not be located above a residential proximity slope. (See Section 51A-4.412.) Exception: Structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Stories
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.111. STORIES.

Maximum number of stories permitted on the Property is two. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Residential Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.112. RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

Except as otherwise provided, the development standards of the MF-2(A) Multifamily District apply to all residential development. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.113. SCREENING.

An eight-foot-high solid wooden fence with masonry columns at 10 feet on center must be constructed along the west and south property lines, as shown on the conceptual plan. The finished side of the fence must face the contiguous single family area. Masonry does not include cinder blocks. A four- foot-high continuous berm or a combination berm and evergreen hedge must be located along Greenville Avenue and the private drive as shown on the conceptual plan, exclusive of drive approaches and visibility triangles. All screening must be installed before the issuance of a certificate of occupancy. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Visual Intrusion
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.114. VISUAL INTRUSION.

Development must comply with the visual intrusion provision of Section 51A-4.122(8)(B). No balconies are permitted above eight feet in height, measured from grade, on a facade that faces a Residential District. For purposes of this condition, balcony means a platform that projects from the exterior wall of a building. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.115. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Off-street parking and loading for each use must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.116. LANDSCAPING.

A landscape plan must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission at the same time as each detailed development plan. The landscape plan must incorporate the landscaping shown on the conceptual plan. All landscaping must be installed in accordance with Article X. All trees over four inches in caliper along the west, north, and south property lines must be preserved. All plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Reflective Glass
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.117. REFLECTIVE GLASS.

The exterior visible reflectance percentage of glass used for exterior building material must not exceed 27 percent. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Exterior Lighting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.118. EXTERIOR LIGHTING.

No parking lot lighting fixtures may exceed a height of 10 feet. Parking lot illumination may not exceed a maximum of five footcandles. All exterior lighting must be directed toward the ground and must be of a non-neon light source. The intensity of spillover light on neighboring lots, measured at a point five feet above the ground surface, may not exceed 0.1 footcandle. All exterior lighting, except for lighting used for security purposes, must be turned off no later than one hour after business closure or midnight, whichever occurs first. Security lighting must be identified on the detailed development plan. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Pick-Ups And Deliveries
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.119. PICK-UPS AND DELIVERIES.

Pick-ups and deliveries, including the pick-up of refuse, must be limited to the hours between 6:00 a.m. and 12:00 midnight. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.120. SIGNS.

Except as otherwise provided, all signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. One non-premise sign is permitted on the Property if it complies with the requirements contained in Division 51A-7.400. A maximum of two detached signs are permitted on the Property. Exposed neon tube lighting is prohibited. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Facades
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.121. FACADES.

First story facades facing Greenville Avenue and Forest Lane and all second story facades must be constructed of masonry with optional wood trim, exclusive of openings. Masonry does not include cinder blocks and must have a finished surface. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25058)

sections.title: Pedestrian Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.122. PEDESTRIAN ACCESS.

The applicant shall construct a pedestrian facility for the mobility impaired at the contiguous property line between this site and the property to the northwest. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.123. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Development of the Property must comply with the requirements of all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.124. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.125. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-327.126. ZONING MAP.

PD 327 is located on Zoning Map Nos. D-8 and E-8. (Ord. Nos. 20532; 25850)
